title: Glowing scooter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='42' ry='22' fill='#1a3a2a' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='70' r='10' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='70' r='6' fill='#7a7aa0'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#c8c8e8'/>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='70' r='10' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='70' r='6' fill='#7a7aa0'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#c8c8e8'/>
  <!-- deck -->
  <rect x='32' y='60' width='38' height='8' rx='4' fill='#00e5a0'/>
  <rect x='32' y='60' width='38' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5cffcb'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='68' y='28' width='5' height='36' rx='2.5' fill='#00c88a'/>
  <rect x='68' y='28' width='2' height='36' rx='1' fill='#5cffcb'/>
  <!-- handlebar -->
  <rect x='58' y='24' width='24' height='6' rx='3' fill='#00e5a0'/>
  <rect x='58' y='24' width='24' height='2.5' rx='1.25' fill='#5cffcb'/>
  <!-- handlebar grips -->
  <rect x='56' y='22' width='5' height='10' rx='2.5' fill='#ff6ec7'/>
  <rect x='79' y='22' width='5' height='10' rx='2.5' fill='#ff6ec7'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='44' r='5' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='44' r='3' fill='#fff5b0'/>
  <!-- light beam -->
  <polygon points='81,42 98,34 98,54 81,46' fill='#ffe66d' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- rear fender -->
  <path d='M16,66 Q18,56 30,56' stroke='#00c88a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front fender -->
  <path d='M64,62 Q66,54 78,54' stroke='#00c88a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- kickstand -->
  <line x1='45' y1='68' x2='40' y2='80' stroke='#7a7aa0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkle -->
  <g fill='#fff5b0'>
    <path d='M20,30 l2,-6 l2,6 l6,2 l-6,2 l-2,6 l-2,-6 l-6,-2 z'/>
    <path d='M88,16 l1.5,-4 l1.5,4 l4,1.5 l-4,1.5 l-1.5,4 l-1.5,-4 l-4,-1.5 z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
